description: Rework frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx into a coherent management UI (only when authenticated): list existing quizzes with per-quiz edit/delete actions alongside the existing create capability. Edit uses full-replace (PUT) and prefills the existing dynamic form from the answerIndex-inclusive admin GET; delete prompts a confirmation dialog before calling DELETE and refreshes the list. Reuse the EXACT existing validation rules, the answerIndex-over-non-empty-options computation, and the Cognito/token/401/403 handling. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: Import the new api methods and types: getQuizzes, getAdminQuiz, updateQuiz, deleteQuiz, and types QuizSummary, AdminQuizDetail, UpdateQuizInput (plus keep createQuiz, AuthError, CreateQuizInput, AdminQuestionInput, CreateQuizResponse).

Add a form-mode model: a state like mode: { kind: 'create' } | { kind: 'edit'; quizId: string }. In create mode keep the current behavior (POST createQuiz, quizId field editable and optional, /^[a-z0-9-]+$/ validation). In edit mode the quizId is fixed from the selected quiz (do NOT auto-generate, do NOT show the editable quizId input as a free field; show it read-only or as a heading) and submit calls updateQuiz(quizId, { title, questions }, token) (PUT).

Add admin quiz LIST section shown when authenticated: on login/mount (when authenticated) call getQuizzes() and render each quiz with title + questionCount and two buttons '編集' (edit) and '削除' (delete). Also keep a '新規作成' (create) affordance to reset the form into create mode. Manage list loading/empty/error states (reuse status pattern and the 'クイズがありません' empty microcopy semantics; loading like 'クイズを読み込み中...'). Keep the single-page layout coherent: a list section plus the form section below it (switching into edit mode loads the quiz into the same form).

Implement enterEditMode(quizId): call getAdminQuiz(quizId, token) (answerIndex-inclusive), then reconstruct the form state: set title, set quizId (fixed), and build questions[] via the existing QuestionState/OptionRow model using nextId() for fresh row ids. For each server question map options[] to OptionRow rows and set isCorrect=true on the row at position answerIndex (isCorrect false on the rest). This is the inverse of collectPayload's answerIndex-over-non-empty-options computation; since server options are all non-empty, the DOM index equals answerIndex. Set mode to { kind: 'edit', quizId }. Clear any prior result. Handle getAdminQuiz errors: AuthError -> clearToken + reset auth + login-needed message (same as create path); 403 -> show its '権限がありません' message; other errors -> show err message (e.g. 404 -> server message).

Refactor collectPayload so the SAME validation rules and answerIndex computation are reused for BOTH create and edit. In create mode it still returns CreateQuizInput including the optional quizId (with /^[a-z0-9-]+$/ validation). In edit mode produce the UpdateQuizInput shape { title, questions } (no quizId in the PUT body; path wins). Keep every existing Japanese validation message EXACTLY: 'タイトルを入力してください。', '問題を 1 つ以上追加してください。', '問題 ' + qNo + ' の問題文を入力してください。', '問題 ' + qNo + ' には空でない選択肢を 2 つ以上入力してください。', '問題 ' + qNo + ' の正解を選択してください。', '問題 ' + qNo + ' の正解は空でない選択肢を選んでください。', 'クイズ ID は半角英小文字・数字・ハイフンのみ使用できます。'. Do NOT weaken or reorder these checks.

Update handleSubmit: build payload via the shared validation; if !isAuthenticated || !idToken keep the existing 'ログインが必要です（認証エラー）' handling and token reset; then in create mode call createQuiz and on success set the existing success result card (keep 'クイズを登録しました。' semantics) and refresh the list; in edit mode call updateQuiz and on success show an edit-success message distinct from create (e.g. 'クイズを更新しました。' with quizId + questionCount) and refresh the list. On AuthError in either mode: clearToken + reset auth + 'ログインが必要です（認証エラー）'. On other errors: show err message. Keep the 'registering'/'updating' in-progress status text (e.g. '登録中...' for create, '更新中...' for edit).

Implement handleDelete(quizId, title): show a confirmation before deleting. Use window.confirm with a clear Japanese message (e.g. '「' + title + '」を削除します。よろしいですか？') OR a small accessible in-app modal (keep it simple). Only if confirmed and authenticated, call deleteQuiz(quizId, token); on success refresh the list (getQuizzes) and show a brief success status (e.g. 'クイズを削除しました。'); if the deleted quiz was the one loaded in edit mode, reset the form back to create mode. Handle errors like the create path: AuthError (401) -> clearToken + reset auth + login-needed; 403 -> '権限がありません' message; 404/other -> show err message.

Preserve ALL existing behavior: Cognito login/logout via loginUrl()/logoutUrl(), the COGNITO_DOMAIN/COGNITO_CLIENT_ID unset guard message, restoreToken/captureTokenFromHash on mount, isAuthenticated memo, sessionStorage token handling, the 'index.html' back-link and 'クイズアプリで確認する' link. Keep the login-view (unauthenticated) unchanged. Do not change auth.ts or config.ts.

Use existing CSS classes where possible (card, btn/primary/small, admin-toolbar, admin-form, admin-field, admin-input, admin-question, admin-options, admin-option, option-correct/option-text, admin-question-controls, admin-actions, admin-result, status/error, empty-state). If new elements need styling (e.g. an admin quiz list, edit-mode heading, per-quiz action row, or a modal), add classes here and coordinate with FEAT-003 which owns styles.css; prefer adding the class usage now and let FEAT-003 provide the polished CSS. Reasonable new class names: admin-quiz-list, admin-quiz-item, admin-quiz-actions, admin-mode-heading.
acceptance_criteria: When authenticated, AdminPage lists existing quizzes (title + questionCount) with per-quiz '編集' and '削除' buttons and a create affordance.

Clicking '編集' fetches via getAdminQuiz (answerIndex-inclusive) and prefills the form: title, fixed quizId, questions with options and the correct radio set from answerIndex; submitting calls updateQuiz (PUT) not createQuiz.
In edit mode the quizId is fixed (not auto-generated, not freely editable); in create mode the quizId field remains optional and validated by /^[a-z0-9-]+$/.
Clicking '削除' prompts a confirmation dialog and only calls deleteQuiz after the user confirms; on success the list refreshes.
The exact existing Japanese validation messages and the answerIndex-over-non-empty-options computation are reused unchanged for both create and edit.
401 -> clearToken + prompt re-login (existing message); 403 -> '権限がありません' semantics, in create, edit, and delete paths.
All existing auth/token/login/logout behavior and the back/confirm links are preserved.
verification: Read frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx and confirm: create still uses createQuiz(POST); edit uses updateQuiz(PUT) with fixed quizId; delete uses deleteQuiz behind a confirm; getAdminQuiz used for prefill; validation messages byte-identical to the originals; imports resolve against api.ts (FEAT-001).
Trace the answerIndex reconstruction: for a server question with answerIndex k, the k-th OptionRow has isCorrect=true and re-running collectPayload on unchanged options yields the same answerIndex k.
On the user's networked host: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build (tsc + vite must pass).
Confirm no changes to auth.ts, config.ts, backend, or amplify.yml.
findings:
Implemented in frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx ONLY (297 insertions / 33 deletions). Committed as 513d0db on branch feat/admin-ui-polish. No changes to api.ts, auth.ts, config.ts, HomePage.tsx, styles.css, backend, or amplify.yml; no npm deps or lockfile added.

WHAT WAS ADDED:
- FormMode type: { kind: 'create' } | { kind: 'edit'; quizId: string }. New state: mode, quizzes (QuizSummary[]), listLoading, listError.
- Quiz LIST section (card.admin-quiz-list-card) shown when authenticated: loaded via getQuizzes() in a useEffect keyed on isAuthenticated (also cleared on logout). Renders ul.admin-quiz-list > li.admin-quiz-item with title (.admin-quiz-title), '問題数: {questionCount}' (.admin-quiz-count), and .admin-quiz-actions with '編集'/'削除' buttons. States: loading 'クイズを読み込み中...', error (status error), empty 'クイズがありません' (.empty-state). A '新規作成' button (.btn primary small) resets to create mode.
- enterEditMode(quizId): guards auth (401->handleAuthError), calls getAdminQuiz(quizId, token) (answerIndex-inclusive), reconstructs QuestionState/OptionRow with fresh nextId() ids; each option row gets isCorrect = (idx === q.answerIndex). Since server options are all non-empty, DOM index === answerIndex, so re-running collectPayload yields the same answerIndex (verified by tracing). Sets title, fixed quizId, mode=edit. Errors: AuthError->handleAuthError; 403/'権限がありません' and 404/other surface via err.message.
- collectPayload REUSED unchanged for both modes; the only change is wrapping the quizId section in `if (mode.kind === 'create')` so edit mode never validates/sends quizId (path wins). All 7 Japanese validation messages are byte-identical (verified via git show + grep diff): the 5 single-line ones matched by comm, and the 4 qNo-based ones matched line-for-line against HEAD.
- handleSubmit: shared validation via collectPayload; unauth -> existing 'ログインが必要です（認証エラー）' + token reset. Create: '登録中...' -> createQuiz(POST) -> success result card ('クイズを登録しました。') + loadQuizzes(). Edit: '更新中...' -> updateQuiz(quizId,{title,questions},token)(PUT) -> distinct success status 'クイズを更新しました。（クイズ ID: .. / 問題数: ..）' + loadQuizzes(). AuthError in either -> handleAuthError(); other errors -> err.message.
- handleDelete(quizId, title): window.confirm('「'+title+'」を削除します。よろしいですか？') gate; only when confirmed+auth calls deleteQuiz(quizId, token); on success 'クイズを削除しました。' + loadQuizzes(); if the deleted quiz was loaded in edit mode, resetToCreate(). AuthError->handleAuthError; 403/404/other -> err.message.
- Extracted handleAuthError() to centralize the 401 clearToken+reset+message flow used by create/edit/delete/enterEditMode.
- Edit-mode form shows quizId READ-ONLY (not auto-generated, not a free field); create-mode keeps the optional quizId input with /^[a-z0-9-]+$/ validation. Form heading (.admin-mode-heading) switches 'クイズを新規作成' / 'クイズを編集'; edit mode adds a 'キャンセル' (back to create) button and a '更新する' submit; create keeps '登録する'.
- Preserved ALL auth behavior: Cognito login/logout (loginUrl/logoutUrl), COGNITO_DOMAIN/COGNITO_CLIENT_ID unset guard, restoreToken/captureTokenFromHash on mount, isAuthenticated memo, sessionStorage handling, login-view, both 'index.html' links, and 'クイズアプリで確認する'.

NEW CSS CLASSES applied (styling deferred to FEAT-003 which owns styles.css): admin-quiz-list-card, admin-quiz-list-header, admin-quiz-list, admin-quiz-item, admin-quiz-title, admin-quiz-count, admin-quiz-actions, admin-mode-heading.

USER MUST verify on networked host: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build (runs tsc -b && vite build).
